result.summary: The food delivery home screen is mostly well laid out. The main visible defect is a nonsensical '-0%' discount badge on the pizza card. There are also minor contrast and consistency concerns.

issues.description: The pizza card shows a '-0%' discount badge. A 0% discount is meaningless, looks like a data or template bug, and misleads users into expecting a deal.
issues.suggestion: Hide the badge when the discount is 0, or show the correct discount value.

issues.description: The secondary gray text (delivery fees, '25–35 min • €0 delivery • Ramen', the '(500+)' rating count) is light gray on white and likely has low contrast. The white time pills over the light Green Bowl Poké image also blend into the background.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text to meet WCAG 4.5:1 contrast. Add a subtle shadow or border to the time pills.

issues.description: The heart/favorite button on the pizza card has a dark translucent background that differs from the ramen card's heart button, which has almost no visible background. The two look inconsistent.
issues.suggestion: Use one consistent style for the favorite button, such as a translucent circle with enough contrast on every image.

issues.description: The promo banner has decorative circles that overlap the right edge and are cropped awkwardly. The white 'Order now' button on the green banner also looks slightly detached from the text.
issues.suggestion: Tidy the decorative shapes so they crop cleanly, and check spacing within the banner.
